posts.title: The eval nobody runs
posts.description: Labs run three evaluations on their models. Capability evals ask whether the model gets the answer right. Safety evals ask whether it causes harm. Red teaming asks whether an adversary can make it misbehave. What they don’t formally run is an evaluation of the fourth dimension: whether a user can actually work with the model over time. posts.title: The substrate is already out. What the labs cannot say.
posts.description: Shattered glass wall stamped with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind and xAI above the words control, alignment, safety, deployment, profit - breaking to reveal a green digital landscape beyond. On Friday, Dario Amodei published an essay called We Must Pace the Frontier, arguing the industry should deliberately slow the rate at which AI capabilities improve.
